lineage.strategy: Add product-level on-orbit latency capability evidence rather than repeat contract or financial evidence.

observations.fact: Planet reported patented radio systems with crosslinks that were demonstrated in on-orbit tests to support last-minute tasking within minutes and reduce time from tasking request through image acquisition and insight delivery.

risks.risk: The issuer did not quantify commercial adoption, revenue uplift, reliability across the fleet or unit economics from the capability.

unknowns.unknown: Fleet-wide deployment status and customer monetization of the low-latency capability remain undisclosed.

recommendation: Use as source-addressed technical-execution evidence only; Alpha should separately source adoption and economics.
